method: Sequential isolated processes; frozen nine-stone stack, 49 inventory stones, seed 0, 1024 iterations, evaluation256, four CPU workers, unchanged CUDA binary. Search-only wall time excludes setup/teardown. CPU chunk granularity is independent of GPU placement chunks; coordinator backlog is bounded to two submitted GPU result groups. Single-seed screening; CPU/CUDA overlap uses host wrapper intervals, not device execution timestamps.

validation.coverage: Bounded producer lookahead, CPU/GPU chunk independence, ordered results, global evaluator assignment, cache isolation, worker draining/reuse after failure; CPU and CUDA placement parity across chunk boundaries; both platforms and MCTS/artifact workflows.
validation.final_default_run: 174.554 seconds, 1064 evaluations, 111 native calls, 37 CPU result chunks; same ordered tree and native binary as preceding control. No batch overrides.

retained.note: GPU production defaults unchanged. No new YAML fields. In-progress current physics group is additional to the two submitted result groups.

conclusion: Independent CPU chunks and bounded lookahead are implemented. At GPU placement128, CPU chunks32 produced no speedup versus128; native calls still return whole batches. No throughput gain is claimed from splitting CPU chunks. All completed measured trees match the control.
